description: Raised US$2M pre-seed led by Storytime Capital, with BY Venture Partners (UAE/Lebanon) and Garage Capital participating. Founders Farris Nasr and Nithiiyan Skhanthan.
Selected for the first MZN x Hub71 cohort backed by Khalifa Fund and Hub71; no funding amount disclosed.
Launched a free, no-signup AI Visibility Score running 45 automated checks — the first time this agency has shipped self-serve software.

Published a 33-tool audit concluding that no AEO tool tracks any Arabic sovereign model (Falcon-H1 Arabic, ALLaM, Jais 2, Fanar 2.0) — publicly naming the whitespace ZaherAI has been planning to claim.

Post-acquisition product wave under Sitecore: Scrunch MCP connector, Knowledge Studio beta (Notion/SharePoint), expanded Content Gaps, and a redesigned site serving a separate agent-optimised experience.
Opened an investor solicitation page seeking strategic and financial investors, self-describing as a pre-revenue early-stage consultancy. No amount disclosed and no round closed.
Became a shareholder in RaviaCare, a GCC beauty and cosmetics e-commerce launch.

Published product pricing and a named team for the first time: AutoSEO $149/mo ($99/mo annual), AdPilot Audit $250/mo, AI Media Buyer $500/mo, AI Visibility $59/mo. Names an explicit Gulf/Saudi/Emirati Arabic dialect capability.
